data.name: Amritlal
data.gender_notes: Amritlal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amrit means 'nectar' and Lal means 'of the gods'. This name signifies the one who is filled with the divine nectar of immortality. The name Amritlal carries the meaning “Nectar of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amritlal usually hope their child will grow to embody nectar of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with divine blessings and immortality.
data.etymology: Amritlal belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nectar of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amritlal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
